subject: Evidence: feature-flag rollback test, PR sampling & ephemeral runner logs
messages:
From: security-assessor@finbank.com
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: opssvc@thirdparty-qa.com
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request — feature-flag rollback testing and CI runner logs

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the quick intake call earlier. As part of the SIG/SOC2 evidence pack we need to validate two items related to your SDLC controls:

1) Feature-flag rollback procedures and proof they were exercised in production-like conditions (playbooks, rollback run logs, and at least one recent test where a rollback was executed).
2) Sampling of PR gating/code review — high-level methodology plus a CSV of sampled PRs (dates, approvers, merge timestamps) and CI ephemeral runner logs that show the transient credential lifecycle and retention policy.

Can you provide the artifacts or point us to the location we should pull from? Ideally we need the files and a short explanation of sampling rationale by end of week so our assessor can close the intake.

Thanks,
Aaron Chen
Security Assessor — FinBank Corp
security-assessor@finbank.com

Attachments: none
From: irene.choi@redwood.ai
To: security-assessor@finbank.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-25T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — feature-flag rollback testing and CI runner logs

Hi Aaron,

Thanks — looping in engineering and product to assemble a concise bundle. Quick plan:

- Jonas will export ephemeral runner logs (redacted for tokens) and include a short timeline showing credential issuance and TTL.
- I will attach the feature-flag rollback playbook and an anonymized run log from the October 12 canary exercise where we triggered a failover rollback.
- Marissa will provide the PR sampling CSV and notes on how we chose the sample (risk-based, last 90 days, cross-service).

We will redact any sensitive PII and provide an audit-friendly set (logs + narrative). Expect initial bundle by EOD tomorrow; final follow-up if you need deeper traces.

Irene Choi
Sr. Security & Trust Lead | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: featureflag-rollback-playbook-20261025.docx (will send in follow-up)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: irene.choi@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, security-assessor@finbank.com
Date: 2026-10-25T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — ephemeral runner logs + PR sampling CSV

Irene / Aaron — attaching the initial exports. Notes below and in the attached TXT: ephemeral-runner-logs-20261025.txt (redacted):

- Each job run is stamped with issued_at, ttl_seconds, issued_by (service account role), and termination timestamps.
- We scrubbed actual token strings and replaced with <REDACTED>.
- Retention: ephemeral logs stored for 90 days in encrypted bucket; we rotate the bucket keys monthly.
- Example timeline (from file):
  * 2026-10-12T03:15:12Z job-start id=svc-deploy-4321 issued_by=runner-controller ttl=600
  * 2026-10-12T03:22:03Z job-complete id=svc-deploy-4321 termination_signal=0

Feature-flag rollback example: we exercised a canary rollback on 2026-10-12 for service svc-deploy. The rollback playbook steps are: detect -> assess -> stage rollback -> verify traffic shift -> confirm. The attached playbook doc contains the exact checklist and approver roles.

Marissa — CSV will follow but sampling used: top 30 PRs by change size across 4 services over the last 90 days + 10 risk-tagged PRs. Attached is a short README describing fields in the CSV.

Jonas Weber
Engineering Manager, Runtime
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Attachments: ephemeral-runner-logs-20261025.txt (attached), pr-sampling-summary-20261025.csv (coming), featureflag-rollback-playbook-20261025.docx (coming)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: security-assessor@finbank.com
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-26T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — feature-flag rollback testing and CI runner logs

Hi Aaron — attached is the sampling CSV and a short rationale for selection. Quick highlights:

- pr-sampling-summary-20261025.csv contains 40 rows (sample_id, pr_number, service_owner, approvers, created_at, merged_at, change_lines, risk_tag).
- Sampling rationale: risk-based + size stratification; covers both automated and human-reviewed PRs; includes examples of PRs that required rollback coordination.
- For the rollback playbook: we include a stamped log of the October 12 exercise, with the on-call approval chain and verification steps. That exercise was run in a production-like canary environment (10% traffic) and followed the documented checklist.

We also included a short summary of controls around ephemeral runner credentials: issuance, TTL enforcement, and automatic deletion of transient artifacts. If you need raw stackdriver traces we can provide a timeboxed export under NDA.

Thanks — please confirm receipt and whether the redactions are acceptable.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Platform
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: pr-sampling-summary-20261025.csv, featureflag-rollback-playbook-20261025.docx, ephemeral-runner-logs-20261025.txt
